WITH per_funding AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    SUM(sp.aream2) / SUM(sp.volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM scanspatial AS sp
  JOIN projects AS p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE sp.boxy IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.boxx IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.boxx <> 0
    AND sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.volm3 <> 0
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS simple_average_ratio
  FROM per_funding
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  avg_y_vs_x_difference,
  area_to_volume_ratio,
  area_to_volume_ratio - simple_average_ratio AS amount_above_average
FROM with_average
WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > simple_average_ratio;
